cell_text.description: Actual implicated cell population; anatomy, matrix and released vesicles are context/products, not themselves a cell type.
cell_text.title: Cell Text

direction.description: Direction of the named cellular process in process_text, or the cellular quality in quality_text when process_text is empty; not the polarity of the input radiographic/clinical phenotype.
direction.title: Direction

experimental_evidence.description: Actual read primary study findings used for support/contradiction, scoped to a component or whole claim; [] allowed. Put interpretation in reasoning_steps, not this evidence block.
experimental_evidence.title: Experimental Evidence

hypothesis_id.description: Optional current hypothesis ID; omit for the host to assign. Do not invent another hypothesis ID.
hypothesis_id.title: Hypothesis Id

process_text.description: Named cellular process whose direction is assessed; empty for a quality-only abnormality. Do not substitute the macro phenotype's polarity.
process_text.title: Process Text

quality_text.description: Cellular abnormality/quality consistent with process_text and direction. The reasoning endpoint is exactly cell_text + ': ' + quality_text.
quality_text.title: Quality Text

species.description: For inferred claims, intended conclusion species; for direct observations, actual study species. Experiment entries retain their own actual species.
species.title: Species

supporting_document_id.description: Exact document_id returned by read_document for the window containing this quote. Abstract PMID and full-text PMC documents are distinct sources even for the same paper. Paired only with supporting_quote; empty when quote is empty.
supporting_document_id.title: Supporting Document Id

supporting_quote.description: One exact contiguous substring copied from a read window of the named document; never paraphrase or join fragments. Optional main quotation; empty requires supporting_document_id=''.
supporting_quote.title: Supporting Quote

taxon_id.description: Taxon matching claim.species: human=NCBITaxon:9606, mouse=NCBITaxon:10090, rat=NCBITaxon:10116, unknown=NCBITaxon:0; other_model uses its actual taxon.
taxon_id.title: Taxon Id

document_id.description: Exact document_id returned by read_document for the window containing this quote. Abstract PMID and full-text PMC documents are distinct sources even for the same paper.
document_id.title: Document Id

finding.description: The actual study finding, separately from your inferred mechanism or extrapolation. Review speculation is not an experimental finding.
finding.title: Finding

quote.description: One exact contiguous substring copied from a read window of the named document; never paraphrase or join fragments.
quote.title: Quote

scope.description: What this actual study supports/tests. Whole_claim requires the complete claim and applicable species, model, anatomy and experimental conditions. Other-model findings usually have component scope. An unreported phenotype is not a demonstrated negative result.
scope.title: Scope

document_id.description: Exact document_id returned by read_document for the window containing this quote. Abstract PMID and full-text PMC documents are distinct sources even for the same paper.
document_id.title: Document Id

quote.description: One exact contiguous substring copied from a read window of the named document; never paraphrase or join fragments.
quote.title: Quote

span_start.description: Optional exact host-provided absolute offset; omit rather than estimate.
span_start.title: Span Start

assumptions.description: Applicability assumptions, required for inference; empty for literature/phenotype_definition. Do not add assumptions_note/basis_notes.
assumptions.title: Assumptions

basis.description: literature: exact cited facts, no assumptions; inference: cited premises plus assumptions; model_knowledge: learned premise, no citations; phenotype_definition: first input-only step.
basis.title: Basis

citations.description: Exact read-source quotations for this step, not source IDs alone. Empty for model_knowledge/phenotype_definition.
citations.title: Citations

scope.description: Use cell_identity for the step justifying which cell population is implicated; inferred identity needs inference/model_knowledge.
scope.title: Scope

contradicting_document_ids.description: Assessment-level IDs of actually read contradictory sources; missing studies and alternative causes are not contradictions.
contradicting_document_ids.title: Contradicting Document Ids

decision.description: Retain a supported, scientifically defensible prediction with explicit assumptions even without exact-site experiments or a challenge search. Reject concrete defects in necessary premises or unjustifiable applicability, not negative evidence labels alone. Inconclusive when the cell/mechanism or applicability cannot reasonably be justified. Format failures are not scientific decisions.
decision.title: Decision

supporting_document_ids.description: Assessment-level IDs of actually read supporting documents, not unexamined search hits.
supporting_document_ids.title: Supporting Document Ids
